claims.claim: 大麦（Barley）与亚麻（Flax）只能在平原（Plains）生物群落种植
claims.evidence: Barley: 'can only be planted and harvested in the Plains biome, using a Cultivator.'；Flax: 'it can only be grown in the Plains biome.'

claims.claim: 工匠台（Artisan table）需要在获得龙泪（Dragon tear）后建造
claims.evidence: materials: Dragon tear x2, Wood x10；'They require Dragon tears, so they can only be built after killing Moder.'

claims.claim: 平原的常见威胁包括死亡蚊（Deathsquito）和丑地精（Fuling）
claims.evidence: Creatures 词条平原分区列出 Deathsquito、Fuling、Fuling Berserker 等生物

claims.claim: 召唤亚格鲁斯需要收集丑地精图腾（Fuling totem）
